BIO

醫生簡介Bio

蔡醫生從事精神科臨床工作，在醫院管理局任職期間，曾於成人、兒童及青少年、長者精神科，以及酒精及藥物濫用相關部門提供治療，接觸不同年齡及背景人士的精神健康需要。Dr Choi practises clinical psychiatry. While working at the Hospital Authority, Dr Choi provided treatment in adult, child and adolescent, and older adult psychiatry, as well as services related to alcohol and substance misuse, gaining experience of the mental health needs of people across different ages and backgrounds.

蔡醫生曾接受動機式訪談法（Motivational Interviewing）、情緒導向治療（Emotion-Focused Therapy）及認知行為治療（Cognitive Behavioural Therapy）的訓練，並特別關注早年創傷、家庭關係與精神健康之間的連繫，重視理解每位求診者的成長經歷與生活處境。Dr Choi has received training in Motivational Interviewing, Emotion-Focused Therapy and Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, with a particular interest in the connections between early-life trauma, family relationships and mental health. Understanding each person’s developmental experiences and life circumstances is an important part of this approach.

除了精神健康問題的評估與治療，蔡醫生亦提供個別輔導，協助求診者面對成長適應、家庭與人際關係，以及其他人生轉變。Alongside the assessment and treatment of mental health concerns, Dr Choi offers individual counselling to help people navigate personal growth and adjustment, family and interpersonal relationships, and other life transitions.

PHILOSOPHY OF PRACTICE

診療理念Philosophy of practice

  1. 增進自我理解，及早關顧心理需要Deepening self-understanding and attending to psychological needs early

    蔡醫生相信，精神健康的照顧不應只在患病後才開始，也應為每一位希望增進自我了解、提升心理素養的人提供支持。無論是否正面對情緒困擾，都可以透過對話與探索，加深對自身情緒、思考及行為模式的理解，培養調節情緒、應對壓力與經營關係的能力。精神健康照顧不只是患病後的治療，也可以是促進成長、建立內在力量的過程。Dr Choi believes that mental health care should not begin only after illness develops. It should also support anyone who wishes to understand themselves better and develop their psychological awareness. Whether or not someone is experiencing emotional distress, conversation and exploration can deepen their understanding of their emotions, thoughts and patterns of behaviour, while building the ability to regulate emotions, cope with stress and nurture relationships. Mental health care can be not only treatment after illness, but also a process of personal growth and building inner strength.

  2. 無論有沒有診斷，你都值得被好好傾聽Whether or not there is a diagnosis, you deserve to be heard

    許多人遲遲未有求診，或許是不肯定自己是否「真的有病」，也可能擔心被貼上標籤，於是覺得再等等也無妨。這些顧慮都很自然。蔡醫生認為，精神科醫生的角色不只是作出診斷，也包括在你並未達到診斷標準時，坦誠地讓你知道：你沒有精神疾病。如果有診斷，蔡醫生會細心解釋其意思及你的選擇；如果沒有，蔡醫生會與你一起了解困擾的來源，並共同商討前行的方向，讓你懂得如何保護自己的身心，避免問題在不知不覺間加深。Many people put off seeking help because they are unsure whether they are “really ill”, or worry about being labelled, and so feel it is fine to wait a little longer. These concerns are entirely natural. Dr Choi believes that a psychiatrist’s role is not only to make diagnoses, but also, when someone does not meet diagnostic criteria, to say honestly that they do not have a mental illness. If there is a diagnosis, Dr Choi will explain carefully what it means and what options are available. If there is not, Dr Choi will work with you to understand the source of your difficulties and discuss the way forward together, so that you know how to protect your mental and physical wellbeing and prevent problems from deepening unnoticed.

  3. 及早介入，提供個別化而有溫度的照顧Early intervention with personalised, compassionate care

    每個人的經歷、困難與步伐都不相同。蔡醫生重視聆聽與共同商討，致力及早辨識需要，按個人的處境、意願及目標制定治療或輔導計劃，提供兼具專業質素與人情溫度的照顧。Everyone has different experiences, challenges and a pace of their own. Dr Choi values listening and shared discussion, aiming to identify needs early and develop treatment or counselling plans that reflect each person’s circumstances, preferences and goals, offering care that combines professional quality with human warmth.

02 / AREAS OF CARE

服務範圍Areas of care

兒童及青少年精神科服務Child and adolescent psychiatry

關顧兒童及青少年的情緒、行為及成長需要，並了解他們在家庭、學校及人際關係中面對的困難。Caring for the emotional, behavioural and developmental needs of children and adolescents, and understanding the difficulties they face at home, at school and in their relationships.

  • 專注力不足／過度活躍症（ADHD）Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)
  • 自閉症譜系障礙Autism spectrum disorder
  • 抽動症Tic disorders
  • 情緒困擾、抑鬱及焦慮Emotional distress, depression and anxiety
  • 強迫症Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD)
  • 行為及情緒調節困難Behavioural and emotional regulation difficulties
  • 上學相關困難及適應問題School-related difficulties and adjustment issues
  • 飲食失調Eating disorders
  • 睡眠困擾Sleep difficulties

成人精神科服務Adult psychiatry

協助處理情緒、思緒、行為及生活適應方面的困擾，關顧精神健康與日常生活的需要。Helping with difficulties involving emotions, thoughts, behaviour and adjustment to life, while caring for mental health and everyday needs.

  • 抑鬱症Depression
  • 躁鬱症（雙相情緒障礙）Bipolar disorder
  • 焦慮症，包括廣泛焦慮症、社交焦慮症及驚恐症Anxiety disorders, including generalised anxiety disorder, social anxiety disorder and panic disorder
  • 強迫症Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD)
  • 失眠及睡眠困擾Insomnia and sleep difficulties
  • 工作壓力、適應困難及哀傷相關困擾Work-related stress, adjustment difficulties and grief-related concerns
  • 創傷後壓力症Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
  • 成人專注力不足／過度活躍症（ADHD）Adult attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)
  • 思覺失調Psychosis
  • 飲食失調Eating disorders
  • 酒精、藥物使用及其他成癮相關困擾Concerns related to alcohol, drug use and other addictions

長者精神科服務Older adult psychiatry

關顧晚年情緒、記憶及認知方面的變化，並重視生活功能與照顧需要。Caring for changes in mood, memory and cognition in later life, with attention to daily functioning and care needs.

  • 抑鬱症及焦慮症Depression and anxiety disorders
  • 失眠及睡眠困擾Insomnia and sleep difficulties
  • 記憶力下降及認知功能評估Memory decline and cognitive assessment
  • 認知障礙症（腦退化症）Dementia
  • 認知障礙相關的情緒及行為問題Emotional and behavioural difficulties associated with dementia
  • 幻覺、妄想及其他精神症狀Hallucinations, delusions and other psychiatric symptoms
  • 退休、喪親及生活轉變相關的適應困難Adjustment difficulties related to retirement, bereavement and life changes
  • 家屬及照顧者支援Support for family members and carers
